name: Smart Living Allen Genoa
loanTerms: 5-yr fixed at 5.71% with a 2% rate buydown, 2-year I/O then 30-year amortization
note: Kevin's 21 Sep original marketed 20.9% IRR / 2.3x / $158 PSF / $188K exit / 7.1% YoC / Feb close. Kirsh's 2 Oct restatement (20.3% / 2.25x / 9.9% CoC, $11.65M equity, 5-yr full-term I/O at 6.69%) is the set all 83 firms before 27 Oct were shown. The figures here are Kevin's 26 Oct re-underwrite, now in market: the debt moved from full-term I/O at 6.69% to a 5.71% fixed coupon with a 2% buydown and only two years of I/O, which lifts the IRR but drops stabilized cash-on-cash from 9.9% to 9.5% once amortization starts. Equity went $11.65M to $11.77M. Whether Chip's 2% equity broker fee is inside that $120K increase is not established - he put the fee at roughly $233K.
